challenge.better_approach: Looked at (a) a question per wait, which holds the crossing today but is for choices only Akien's head settles, and a wait is a measurement; (b) widening the questions lane, which mixes two things. A new lane beside the existing six is the smallest honest move.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That outcome `after` ticket ids and stage_needs are the declared dependency and are adopted by the plans that need them: 86cccb7d30f7 is a decisions plan, which has no `after`, so it must be recast as outcomes or carry a BUILDME need. Also assumed: a ticket's PROVED state is readable from its state record or journal by the lane.
challenge.prior_art: In-house: 43905593680a stage-needs (the ledger and the mark door, shipped 2026-07-26, child b `cairn whatsnext` reads it) and 7a8d78fe0aff (stage_needs vs chart_notes split). Grepped tickets and questions for needs.py and stage_needs: no ticket gates BUILDME on it. Instance of the gap: 86cccb7d30f7 (waits on tester 21f9628872da PROVED and on akiendell pinned).
challenge.real_collision: None found. It adds a lane and changes no existing one; needs.py's own gate (marks need when and how_measured) is what the lane leans on, not what it changes.

answers.falsifier: A scratch ticket whose outcome `after` names an unproved ticket id, or whose BUILDME need has no DONE mark, is refused at the BUILDME entry with each unmet dependency named; the same ticket with the dependency PROVED and the need marked DONE crosses.
answers.from_idea: none, because it is a measured gap: ticket 43905593680a (stage-needs, cairn/tools/base/needs.py) built the ledger and no BUILDME lane reads it; see cairn/tools/base/transitions.py inspect_entry
answers.how: First-cut, a hypothesis: add one lane to inspect_entry in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py that reads the plan's outcome `after` ticket ids (already shape-checked at cast, cairn/tools/base/plan_shape.py) and the ticket's stage_needs BUILDME ledger (cairn/tools/base/needs.py, latest observation mark per need), and names every unmet one in a single finding; red-first proof over scratch tickets.
answers.traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy: 'BUILDME waits on X' written in how text holds nothing) and Law 3 (a need's DONE is a measurement with when and how_measured).
answers.what: A ticket's BUILDME crossing is held until every ticket it declares a dependency on is PROVED and every measured need it declares for BUILDME carries a DONE mark, so a wait is physics and not prose.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-19: inspect_entry has six lanes (chart, intent, sorted, open questions, outcome claims, outline check) and none reads a dependency on another ticket; outcome `after` is only shape-checked at cast and stage_needs is read by no entry lane.
First instance: 86cccb7d30f7 waits on 21f9628872da PROVED and on akiendell pinned to the Dell (known/akiendell.pem present in the Dell's tls dir), both prose today.
